purpose: Allow ADV_Elite and other JANUS nodes to author canonical JSON events and request durable GitHub publication without storing GitHub credentials on ESP32-class devices.

authoritative_functions: compute record_hash and local Witness chain
retry until durable ACK or retention policy expires

gateway_auth.secret_scope: gateway-ingest only; cannot access GitHub directly

gateway_side.deployment: any trusted always-on LAN host/NAS/PC capable of HTTP(S) service + GitHub API access
functions: return durable publication ACK with repository/path/commit SHA
preserve failed publication debt for retry
must_not: hold swarm operation hostage when GitHub is offline

interesting.batch_policy: rotate by bounded record count/size/time; exact budget set by profiling

anomaly.publication: immediate anomaly-onset record, then finalized episode bundle
anomaly.debounce: one onset publication per anomaly episode; do not commit every sample

publication_ack.node_rule: do not clear mandatory outbox entry until matching durable ACK is recorded

github_auth.prototype: fine-grained PAT stored only as a gateway secret and limited to required repositories with Contents:write
github_auth.preferred_long_term: GitHub App installation authentication on gateway with short-lived installation tokens
github_auth.api: GitHub REST repository contents or Git data API

availability.when_gateway_absent: continue solo/swarm operation; retain registry_outbox/archive debt
availability.fallback: storage-capable peer may hold sealed JSON chunk until a gateway becomes reachable
availability.multi_gateway_future: allowed; advertise REGISTRY_GATEWAY capability and deduplicate by record_id/hash

security_truth_rules: GitHub secret never resides in firmware image
gateway credential has minimum repository permissions
node HMAC key cannot commit to GitHub
GitHub availability never becomes a requirement for sensing/learning/mining
anomaly publication means detector fired, not that the event is physically extraordinary
record hash proves integrity, not truth
